children.name: text
children.textContent: Designing with clarity, character, and a little tension.

children.name: text
children.textContent: I’m Alex Morgan — an independent designer and creative strategist helping ambitious people make work that is clear enough to understand, and distinctive enough to remember.

children.name: section
text
children.textContent: A practice built between the lines.

children.name: text
children.textContent: I started in studios where every detail had a reason, then moved closer to the people and problems behind the brief. Today I work across identity, digital products, and creative direction — bringing a strategist’s questions and a designer’s instinct to the same table.

children.name: text
children.textContent: The best work usually starts with a useful disagreement: a sharper question, a more honest constraint, or a point of view that has not been made visible yet. My role is to find that tension, give it form, and make it usable for the people who need it.
